verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI coding agent, so the axis applies. The evidence describes Jules only as a Google-hosted service: tasks run in cloud virtual machines, and API keys are created in the Jules web app. No source release, deployable package, or on-premises option is documented, so absence of evidence for this applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
